tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Study-level summary/characteristics per drug group (IFX, ADA, CZP): N, dose ranges, median number of doses in pregnancy.
tables.note: This is an aggregate/summary table (counts, medians, ranges), not per-patient data; none of its aggregate values appear in the baseline CSV of individual patient rows.

tables.label: Table 2 (IFX)
tables.caption: Per-patient infliximab (IFX) dose, dosing interval, time from dose to birth, IFX concentration in mother/cord/infant at birth, cord/mother ratio, and month IFX became undetectable.
tables.note: Baseline rows with Drug name=Infliximab and Parameter type 'Concentration'/'Ratio cord/Mother (%)' match this table's per-patient values.

tables.label: Table 3 (ADA)
tables.caption: Per-patient adalimumab (ADA) dose, dosing interval, time from dose to birth, ADA concentration in mother/cord/infant at birth, cord/mother ratio, and follow-up ADA levels.
tables.note: Baseline rows with Drug name=Adalimumab and Parameter type 'ADA(μg/ml) at Birth - ...'/'Ratio Cord/Mother' match this table's per-patient values.

tables.label: Table 4 (CZP)
tables.caption: Per-patient certolizumab pegol (CZP) and PEG concentrations in mother/cord/infant at day of birth, and cord/mother ratio.
tables.note: Baseline rows with Drug name=Certolizumab pegol / Analyte=PEG and Parameter type 'Day of Birth CZP/PEG concentrations ...' match this table's per-patient values.
